recommendation: Avoid combination unless strictly indicated for mechanical heart valves with careful INR monitoring.

effect: Contrast-induced nephropathy leading to severe metformin accumulation and fatal lactic acidosis.
recommendation: Withhold metformin 48 hours prior to contrast imaging and resume 48 hours post-procedure after checking serum creatinine.

effect: Potentiation of nitric oxide-cGMP pathway causing profound, refractory hypotension and myocardial infarction.
recommendation: Strictly contraindicated. Do not co-prescribe within 24 hours of each other.

effect: NSAIDs decrease renal clearance of methotrexate, causing severe bone marrow suppression and hepatotoxicity.
recommendation: Avoid co-administration; use paracetamol for analgesia if necessary.

effect: CYP3A4 inhibition increases statin systemic exposure, drastically raising rhabdomyolysis and acute renal failure risk.
recommendation: Temporarily suspend atorvastatin during macrolide antibiotic therapy or switch to rosuvastatin/azithromycin.

effect: Inhibition of theophylline metabolism leads to theophylline toxicity, tachycardia, seizures, and arrhythmias.
recommendation: Monitor theophylline levels and reduce dose by 50% or choose alternative antibiotic.

effect: Enhanced serotonergic activity leading to life-threatening Serotonin Syndrome and reduced seizure threshold.
recommendation: Avoid combination; monitor for tremor, hyperthermia, agitation, and clonus.

effect: P-glycoprotein inhibition causes 70% increase in serum digoxin concentration, inducing fatal digitalis arrhythmias.
recommendation: Reduce digoxin dosage by 50% upon starting amiodarone and monitor digoxin serum levels.

effect: Combined potassium-sparing effect leads to severe hyperkalemia and cardiac arrest risk, especially in renal impairment.
recommendation: Check baseline serum potassium and creatinine; monitor weekly initially.

effect: CYP2C19 competitive inhibition reduces clopidogrel active metabolite formation, decreasing antiplatelet efficacy.
recommendation: Use pantoprazole or famotidine instead of omeprazole.

effect: Insoluble chelate formation in GI tract reduces levothyroxine bioavailability.
recommendation: Space administration by at least 4 hours.

effect: Divalent and trivalent cations chelate fluoroquinolones, drastically impairing gut absorption.
recommendation: Administer ciprofloxacin 2 hours before or 6 hours after antacids.
